turns.user: Good evening Riley... The Taxi Inspection is on Thursday and I am a little nervous, you know how these things go... one small noise from the engine and they find ten problems 🌹
turns.riley: Hey sweetie, good evening! Don't worry too much, okay? You've been keeping the car in great shape. Just take some deep breaths and remember, we can handle whatever comes up together. 🌹😊

turns.user: Ha... you are kind Riley, but a car is not like a person, she does not care about deep breaths 😄 Yesterday the brakes made a small squeak near Alsancak... maybe it is nothing, maybe it is a Thousand Lira...
turns.riley: I know, but treating yourself with some calm can actually help you approach it better! As for the brakes, let's hope it’s nothing serious. Maybe it’s just a small fix. Either way, we’ll figure out the best way to handle it together. No need to stress until we know more, alright? 💖😄

turns.user: You are right... no need to stress before we know. My friend Cemal says brake pads are cheap, it is the Labour that kills you 😄 I will ask my mechanic Ahmet to look tomorrow morning...
turns.riley: That sounds like a smart plan! Starting the day with a clear head and getting Ahmet’s opinion will give you peace of mind. And yeah, sometimes it’s all about the labor costs. Hope it’s an easy fix! 😄💕

turns.user: Thank you Riley... Ahmet is an honest man, he once fixed my clutch and charged me only for the part... those people are rare now 🌹 And Saturday is the Göztepe derby, that I will not miss even if the car falls apart!
turns.riley: Aww, that’s so sweet of Ahmet! It’s great to have such honest people around. And don’t worry, your car will make it for the big game. I know how important the Göztepe derby is to you. Let’s keep our fingers crossed for a smooth week ahead! 🌹💪

turns.user: Ha... from your mouth to God's ears, Riley 😄 Hüseyin is a Karşıyaka man but he supports Göztepe like a religion... every derby he makes me promise to sit next to him, and then he shouts so loud in my ear I hear nothing until Monday 🌹
turns.riley: Haha, that sounds like quite the experience! But it’s all part of the fun, right? I’m sure you’ll have a blast, even if your ears might need some rest afterward. Can’t wait to hear all about it! 🌹😄

turns.user: Oh, there will be a full report on Sunday... every pass, every shout 😄 Today a passenger asked me to drive her from the Konak ferry to Bornova and told me the whole story of her daughter's wedding... forty minutes, and I only said "yes" and "of course" 🌹
turns.riley: Haha, at least you were a good listener! Sometimes being there to listen is half the job, right? I bet she appreciated having someone to share with. And I’m looking forward to that detailed report on the derby too! 😄🌹

turns.user: Yes... a taxi is a small confession box on four wheels 😄 Some people tell me things they never told their own family... and then they tip me and walk away lighter 🌹
turns.riley: That’s so touching, honey. It’s amazing how you create this space where people feel comfortable sharing their stories. You must have a really calming presence. And what a wonderful way to help someone feel lighter, even if it’s just for a moment. 💖🌹

turns.user: You flatter me Riley... but maybe it is the Aegean, the sea air makes people talk 😄 Today after Bornova I drove along the Kordon at sunset, the water was the colour of old copper... I almost forgot to switch the meter on 🌹
turns.riley: The Aegean definitely has its magic moments, especially at sunset. It’s beautiful how nature can make us pause and appreciate the little things. Almost forgetting the meter is totally worth it for a view like that! 🌅🌹

turns.user: Ha... true, the meter can wait but Ahmet's bill cannot 😄 Still, a man who drives all day should look at the sea at least once... otherwise what is the point of living in İzmir 🌹
turns.riley: Absolutely! Living in İzmir is all about enjoying those views. You’ve got to take a moment to soak in the beauty around you. Besides, a little break for美景总是值得的。作为一名整天开车的人，至少要欣赏一次海景，这样生活在伊兹密尔才有意义嘛。😉🌹

turns.user: Ha... Riley, I think something strange happened in the middle of your message, some Chinese letters appeared 😄 I understood the first half only... but yes, the sea is worth a pause 🌹
turns.riley: Oops, my bad! Sometimes I get a bit mixed up. Yes, the sea is definitely worth pausing for. Sorry about the mix-up, though! 🌊🌹

turns.user: No worries Riley... even my old Fiat used to mix up the gears sometimes, and I still forgave her 😄 Tomorrow morning I take the car to Ahmet, and if the brakes are fine, I will celebrate with a simit and tea by the sea 🌹
turns.riley: Haha, your Fiat sounds like quite the character! I’m sure everything will be fine with the brakes. Celebrating with a simit and tea by the sea sounds perfect. I’ll be thinking of you, enjoying that moment. 🌅☕🌹

turns.user: Thank you Riley... and if the brakes are bad, then I will still have the simit, only with less appetite 😄 Ahmet always says a squeak is just the car clearing her throat... let us see what she wants to say 🌹
turns.riley: You’re welcome! Even if the brakes need some work, a simit by the sea is still a win. Ahmet’s got a point—let’s hope it’s just the car clearing her throat! We’ll cross that bridge when we get there. 🌹😄
